environment: Desktop Chromium (headless, Google Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12); the comparisons at one device pixel per CSS pixel, the review pictures at two; the preview bundled by Vite and served with the production headers below, the hosted game's own art beside it; the package's pages served unchanged by design/tools/phone-ui-render.mjs's reference server. Not a phone, not Safari, no server, and not a performance measure.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; script-src 'self' https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://www.gstatic.com/recaptcha/; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; media-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://firestore.googleapis.com https://content-firebaseappcheck.googleapis.com https://recaptchaenterprise.googleapis.com https://www.google.com https://us-central1-gamen-mothership-staging.cloudfunctions.net; frame-src https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://recaptcha.google.com/recaptcha/

harness: The preview's phone: the review frames' safe areas (47 px above, 34 px below) given through a preview style rule where a phone gives its own through env(); stand-ins for the ordinary app's header, bar and board; the app's own background (#060C1C) beneath; a fixed clock; each page brought to rest for its picture: every animation and transition held at 300 ms, those that start afterwards too, and a picture taken while anything still runs fails.

packet.what: Frontend's development-only synthetic packet of five inputs for this component's preview, carried here unchanged, byte for byte.
packet.synthetic: All five are synthetic. Four are reconstructed from validated synthetic views and controller flags. The fifth, food-panel-18, is a synthetic equivalent (a retained RELEASE-capable view marked stale), not a connected payload: the connected runner kept neither its view nor its clock.
packet.use: Preview side only, with a fixed clock (clock.now() returns the frame's clock.nowMs), the measured host bars, and the same input on both sides of a comparison.

native.what: Frontend's ten native captures of the same five parts at 390 x 844 and 430 x 932, which the check compares the component with. They are not copied into this repository folder: the check reads them from the commit below and holds each to its SHA-256.
native.connected: The two food-panel-18 captures are from a connected match (other names, characters and stock, and no synthetic safe areas), so they cannot be compared with the packet's synthetic equivalent pixel for pixel.

art.what: The hosted game's own art, written beside the bundle as the game's build emits it (apps/game/hosted/comic-assets.mjs, scripts/crew-drawing-art.mjs, scripts/food-supply-art.mjs)
